title: My Day with Food
text:
Breakfast is my favourite meal. I eat bread, eggs and cheese in the morning. I drink a glass of milk too. My mother makes tea for everyone.

Lunch is at school at twelve o'clock. I eat rice and chicken with my friends. We talk and laugh at the table. After lunch, I like to eat an apple.

questions.text: What does the writer drink in the morning?
What time is lunch at school?
How does the writer probably feel at lunch?
Where does the writer probably eat breakfast?

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a meal eaten in the middle of the day
a bird that people eat as food
a round fruit that is red, green, or yellow

paragraph_translations: Kahvaltı en sevdiğim öğündür. Sabahleyin ekmek, yumurta ve peynir yerim. Bir bardak süt de içerim. Annem herkes için çay yapar.
Öğle yemeği saat on ikide okuldadır. Arkadaşlarımla pilav ve tavuk yerim. Masada konuşur ve gülüşürüz. Öğle yemeğinden sonra bir elma yemeyi severim.
